verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway explicitly documents authentication/authorization plugins supporting JWT, basic auth, OAuth, ACLs, and the README highlights adding authentication to an API in minutes, plus Vaults for securing credentials/secrets referenced by these plugins. mTLS and API key enforcement are standard Kong plugin categories implied by the broader auth plugin ecosystem, though the evidence pack doesn't explicitly enumerate mTLS or API-key plugins by name. missing for 10: explicit documentation citation for mTLS plugin and API-key auth plugin, independent hands-on validation of multi-method auth enforcement.
